title: Two claims on one cash flow
hook: Two stated cases: explore the observed price ratio versus a fixed claim ratio.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the observed price ratio versus a fixed claim ratio affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Ratio, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the observed price ratio versus a fixed claim ratio in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy seller asks 60; a buyer offers 40 for the same item. What is the sell-to-buy ratio?
